title: ASC 740 Income Tax Provision
description: Extension schema for the vwp-accounting-asc740 extension. Constrains a core calculation object of type 'incomeTaxProvision': one jurisdiction and period, pretax income (from a fact), permanent and temporary differences, the valuation allowance and unrecognized tax benefits, and the current, deferred and total provision with the rate reconciliation. Located by type under calculations/. Sign conventions: permanent difference amounts are positive when they increase taxable income; a temporary difference is the cumulative positive book-tax difference, 'deductible' giving rise to a deferred tax asset and 'taxable' to a deferred tax liability; the change in a deductible difference increases taxable income for the period and the change in a taxable difference decreases it.

statutoryRate.description: Enacted rate expected to apply (ASC 740-10-30-8), as a decimal.

amount.description: Positive increases taxable income (non-deductible expense); negative decreases it (tax-exempt income).

openingDifference.description: Cumulative book-tax difference at the start of the period.

closingDifference.description: Cumulative book-tax difference at the end of the period.

rate.description: Enacted rate expected to apply when the difference reverses (ASC 740-10-30-8).

judgmentRef.description: The more-likely-than-not realizability judgment (ASC 740-10-30-5(e)); required when either balance is nonzero.

opening.description: Liability for unrecognized tax benefits at the start of the period.

currentTaxExpense.description: taxableIncome × statutoryRate; negative is a current benefit.

uncertainTaxPositionsExpense.description: Change in the liability for unrecognized tax benefits; zero when none.

deferredTaxExpense.description: Net deferred (opening) − net deferred (closing), where net deferred = gross deferred tax assets − valuation allowance − deferred tax liabilities.

item.description: 'statutory' for pretax income × statutory rate; then one row per reconciling item.
